create_Task_subclass: create a subclass of Task that implements run, request_stop, and step_nr
run_Task: run a Task subclass instance to execute its work loop
request_stop_Task: call request_stop on a Task instance to signal it to stop
get_step_nr_Task: get the current step number from a Task instance via the step_nr property
raise_TaskStopException: raise a TaskStopException to signal that a Task has been stopped
